e.title: Nexus Mutual
e.summary: 去中心化互助保险协议核心合约（180★）：成员承保的智能合约风险互助保险（链上互助模式）
e.body: Nexus Mutual smart-contracts（NexusMutual/smart-contracts，180★）是 Nexus Mutual 协议的核心智能合约：去中心化互助（mutual）保险——成员为智能合约风险/黑客事件提供互助保险（cover），承保决策与理赔由成员投票（DAO 模式），是链上互助保险的代表协议。对 RIAA：去中心化互助保险的协议实现——与 [[etherisc-gif]]（Etherisc 通用框架）、[[hurricaneguard]]（参数险）、[[healthcare-insurance-ethereum]]（理赔 DApp）构成区块链保险生态；理解「互助池+成员承保+DAO 治理」模式与传统保险公司的差异；对网络风险保险（智能合约风险）的新兴承保逻辑有参考。
e.verified_note: repo 页核实：Nexus Mutual 互助保险协议核心合约（成员承保+DAO 治理），180★
e.summary_en: Decentralised mutual-insurance protocol core contracts (180★): member-underwritten mutual cover for smart-contract risks (on-chain mutual model)
e.summary_hk: 去中心化互助保險協議核心合約（180★）：成員承保的智能合約風險互助保險（鏈上互助模式）
e.body_en: Nexus Mutual smart-contracts (NexusMutual/smart-contracts, 180★) are the core smart contracts of the Nexus Mutual protocol: decentralised mutual insurance — members provide mutual cover for smart-contract risks/hack events, with underwriting decisions and claims governed by member voting (DAO model); the representative protocol of on-chain mutual insurance. For RIAA: a protocol implementation of decentralised mutual insurance — with [[etherisc-gif]] (Etherisc's generic framework), [[hurricaneguard]] (parametric) and [[healthcare-insurance-ethereum]] (claims DApp) it forms the blockchain-insurance ecosystem; understand how the 'mutual pool + member underwriting + DAO governance' model differs from traditional insurers; instructive for the emerging underwriting logic of cyber risk (smart-contract risks).
e.body_hk: Nexus Mutual smart-contracts（NexusMutual/smart-contracts，180★）是 Nexus Mutual 協議的核心智能合約：去中心化互助（mutual）保險——成員為智能合約風險/黑客事件提供互助保險（cover），承保決策與理賠由成員投票（DAO 模式），是鏈上互助保險的代表協議。對 RIAA：去中心化互助保險的協議實現——與 [[etherisc-gif]]（Etherisc 通用框架）、[[hurricaneguard]]（參數險）、[[healthcare-insurance-ethereum]]（理賠 DApp）構成區塊鏈保險生態；理解「互助池+成員承保+DAO 治理」模式與傳統保險公司的差異；對網絡風險保險（智能合約風險）的新興承保邏輯有參考。
